reason: Conversation 2 correctly identified E011 as a 'key held too long' fault from the outset and immediately pointed to moisture/residue on the touch panel as the likely cause, matching the hidden truth, then gave the right safety boundary (don't open the panel, Bosch service only if it recurs when dry) and useful prevention advice. Conversation 1 reached the same resolution only because the customer volunteered the wet-cleaning detail, and it muddied the diagnosis with an unsupported claim that E011 can be a temperature sensor fault and a dubious 'short circuit in the control electronics' explanation rather than the capacitive false-touch mechanism. Neither recommended an unnecessary part, but 2's diagnosis was more accurate, honest and complete.
